The semantic-auditor layer added no verifiable independent evidence. gate0_semantic and all four gate_*_auditor results carry placeholder summaries, evidence notes containing only a placeholder note, and no artifacts. Their checks restate the machine gates' values. Each worker result reports one che

Every worker and auditor result has created_at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. That is earlier than the analysis plan's registered_at (2026-04-02) and than the end of the audited quarter, so none of these timestamps can be true.

Machine rules never touch much of the work, and my own check was the only one there. Each channel is about one third PL, DE and CZ, and completion is flat across countries within a channel. So this quarter's channel gap is not a country-mix artifact, although the report's interval caveat still stands.

Both surfaces render the p-values as 0.0000, while the recomputed p is about 3e-157 for completion and below 1e-300 for AOV. 'p < 0.0001' would be the honest rendering. The dashboard's test cards also put p under the generic key 'value' and carry no n_per_group.
The population text of CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV (and of the channel_aov_test_* metrics) does not say 'delivered', although the Welch test runs over delivered orders only (17818 against 12055).
net_revenue is gross_amount minus refund_amount of delivered orders as the export stood. It is not cash received, and the spec does not say whether gross_amount includes shipping or VAT.
The handoff has no drift_since_review field. Its absence does not prove that the code's assumptions hold on this export; they held only for the columns I recomputed.
